entries.causal_hypothesis: After executable profit is established, synchronized nonpositive side-aligned four-bar momentum, MACD histogram and EMA20 distance identifies irrecoverable directional-state collapse. P2 and P1 arms are separate.
entries.decision: Close HYP-024 before MT4 and 2025. Every cell improved its target loss class in every fold, but no cell passed the all-fold aggregate, Winner-tail, strategy, direction, quarter, month and date-removal gates; neither arm formed an eligible connected region.

the synchronized collapse state preserves Winner right tail across folds
either arm forms a portable family region
entries.origin_analysis: The Entry audit closed with zero portable local separators. P2 and P1 landmark analyses showed stronger post-entry separation; a profit-armed synchronized technical collapse family was frozen before outcomes.
